metadata.case_name: DING KWOK KEUNG v. MORETIDE INVESTMENTS LTD

injuries.description: the plaintiff suffered a mild sprain back without neurological complication.
source: the plaintiff suffered a mild sprain back without neurological complication.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: MRI of the lumbar spine was performed on 10 December 2014 which showed mild posterior disc bulging at L4/5 level, with mild compression at the anterior thecal sac. The clinical impression was PID at L4/5.
source: MRI of the lumbar spine was performed on 10 December 2014 which showed mild posterior disc bulging at L4/5 level, with mild compression at the anterior thecal sac. The clinical impression was PID at L4/5.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: his pain was located at the lower lumbar region without local swelling. But there was marked decrease in lumbar flexion movement.
persistent pain in his low back, usually with a sense of tightness requiring stretching
limited tolerance (about an hour) in walking, standing and sitting
He now only has impaired capacity in handling heavy weight.
He experienced some shaking of the lower limbs on climbing stairs
on and off back pain that requires symptomatic treatment on a need to basis

treatments_received: A&E attendance at Princess Margaret Hospital (initial and subsequent attendances)
PMH physiotherapy: attended from 9 October 2013 to 26 February 2014 for a total of 11 sessions
Occupational therapy at CMC: attended from 24 March 2014 to 31 October 2014 for a total of 90 sessions
Outpatient physiotherapy at CMC: attended from 28 August 2014 to 28 October 2014 for a total of 9 sessions
MRI of the lumbar spine on 2014-12-10
Functional Capacity Evaluation conducted on 9 December 2014

losses.description: He now only has impaired capacity in handling heavy weight.
limited tolerance (about an hour) in walking, standing and sitting
the plaintiff is unfit for heaving manual lifting and his working capacity does not meet his pre-accident work demand as lorry driver cum delivery worker
